[SWS_UCM_01013] Too big block size received by
UCM Master
⌈
In the case the
received block size with
TransferData
exceeds the block size returned by
Trans-
ferStart
or
TransferVehiclePackage
for the same TransferId,
UCM Master
shall raise the
ApplicationError IncorrectBlockSize
.
⌋
(RS_UCM_00035)
